Emma (devex): heads up — noticed some weirdness in the next-plugin starter when running the LangChain demo with the Redwood JS SDK. onboarding flow is flaky on auth + retries.
Sam (eng-runtime): ugh, what symptoms? 500s, timeouts, or auth failures?
Emma (devex): mostly 401s on first request after token rotation, then rapid 429s as the client spams retries. seems like the Next edge handler and SDK retry defaults aren't cooperating.
Jules (eng-ml): can you paste the log snippet?
Emma (devex): sure — minimal repro: edge runtime page makes a server-side call to /api/agent which proxies to langchain python via plugin. logs: 
```
2024-06-15T17:12:03Z INFO request id=abc123 status=401 msg="token expired"
2024-06-15T17:12:03Z WARN request id=abc123 retrying (attempt 1)
2024-06-15T17:12:04Z WARN request id=abc123 rate_limit status=429 msg="concurrent burst"
```
Sam (eng-runtime): hmm — Node SDK default retry policy is aggressive (3 immediate retries) while our Python LangChain client default is 0. on token rotation you want a single refresh + one gentle retry, not a tight loop.
Priya (docs): that mismatch would definitely confuse users. our Next starter uses the JS SDK but the sample plugin talks about python agent expectations.
Jules (eng-ml): does the client surface a backoff config in the starter?
Emma (devex): starter currently instantiates client like: 
```
const rw = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
```
no retry/backoff config shown.
Sam (eng-runtime): propose patch: set SDK default to exponential backoff for edge contexts and expose a short snippet in the starter to opt into `retries: 2, backoff: { factor: 2, min: 200 }`. also make the client no-op retry on 401 and instead call a provided refresh hook.
Emma (devex): +1. for sample plugin we should add an explicit example of how to wire token refresh in Next edge/SSR: an `onAuthRefresh` callback that updates cookies and replays once.
Priya (docs): can I volunteer to write the doc blurb and a short code snippet for the starter readme?
Jules (eng-ml): I'll draft the runtime change. sample patch idea: 
```
// next-plugin: api/agent.js
const rw = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  retries: 1,
  backoff: { factor: 2, min: 250 },
  onAuthRefresh: async (ctx) => {
    // refresh cookie or server session
    await refreshSession(ctx)
    return true // replay once
  }
})
```
Emma (devex): also add a short test in the eval harness that simulates token expiry and asserts we don't DoS the backend (i.e., single refresh + single replay).
Sam (eng-runtime): CI-bot — can you add a flaky test to the sample-app pipeline that artificially forces a 401 on first call?
CI-bot: added pipeline step `sample-next:auth-replay-test` to run in PRs.
Priya (docs): tiny UX thing — mention in the quickstart that Edge runtime + long-lived tokens need explicit refresh handling; users often copy-paste starter and hit this.
Emma (devex): I'll open a quick PR against `samples/next-plugin` with the readme change + code snippet and link to the runtime issue.
Jules (eng-ml): created runtime issue #2417 to standardize retry/backoff defaults in SDKs and add `onAuthRefresh` hook.
Sam (eng-runtime): once PR is up ping me, I'll review the runtime bits.
Emma (devex): thanks all — will post PR link here. :sparkles:
Emma (devex): PR: https://git.redwood.example/samples/next-plugin/pull/88 (includes readme + starter snippet + small test)
Sam (eng-runtime): reviewed quick and left a small comment re: cookie path on edge.
Priya (docs): updated docs draft in the PR.
CI-bot: sample-next:auth-replay-test passed on branch.
Emma (devex): merged — marking this closed. follow-up: we should add a small paragraph in the eval harness guide about mocking token expiry for regression checks.
Priya (docs): filing a docs task for that.
Jules (eng-ml): will follow up with a changelog entry for SDK defaults.
Sam (eng-runtime): note for product: maybe add a small telemetry counter for "auth-refresh-replays" so we can detect if many users hit this pattern.
Emma (devex): good idea — created tracking ticket. :white_check_mark:
